errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt die Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen im Marktgebiet von Trading Hub Europe (THE) dar.
errors.evidence: The reference describes two separate diagrams: one for summer deliveries (Sommerlieferungen) and one for annual deliveries (Jahreslieferungen). The machine-generated description conflates them into a single diagram and incorrectly labels it as only showing annual deliveries.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 2025 bis 2027
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the first diagram (summer deliveries) ranges from 2025 to 2027, while the second diagram (annual deliveries) ranges from 2026 to 2029. The machine description incorrectly assigns the range 2025–2027 to a description that also mentions a second line going to 2028.

errors.text_span: Sie beginnt bei 49,5 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2025 und sinkt kontinuierlich auf 33,3 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2027.
errors.evidence: The reference states the first line (summer deliveries) begins at 50 Euro/MWh in 2025 and falls to 30 Euro/MWh in 2027, not 49.5 and 33.3 Euro/MWh respectively.

errors.text_span: Sie beginnt bei 40,2 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2026 und sinkt kontinuierlich auf 29,6 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2028.
errors.evidence: The reference states the second line (annual deliveries) starts at 40 Euro/MWh in 2026 and ends at 27 Euro/MWh in 2029, not 40.2 Euro/MWh to 29.6 Euro/MWh in 2028.

errors.text_span: Die erste Linie ist blau, durchgezogen und verwendet keine Markierungen.
errors.evidence: The reference explicitly states that the lines have square markers (quadratische Markierungen). The machine description incorrectly states no markers are used.

The reference describes two separate diagrams with distinct purposes (Sommerlieferungen and Jahreslieferungen). The machine description fails to correctly identify this two-diagram structure and instead presents a single combined diagram.
The second diagram's x-axis range (2026–2029) is not correctly described. The machine description only mentions 2025–2027 for the x-axis range.
